proposal.summary: The report describes an unquoted service path for Sherpa Connector Service (SherpaConnectorService.exe) in Sherpa Connector Service 2020.2.20328.2050 that may allow a local user to gain elevated privileges by placing a malicious executable at C:\Program Files\Sherpa Software\Sherpa.exe.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the service binary path and whether the service runs as SYSTEM; if confirmed, update the service path to a quoted full path and advise users to remove writable directories from the service path and replace the service with a non-writable install location or apply least-privilege to service account.
